title: Federated Empirical Benchmarking with Differential Privacy Guarantees: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: Sharing proprietary benchmark evaluation datasets across competing research institutions raises severe data privacy concerns. We design a Renyi differentially private federated evaluation protocol that computes Pareto frontiers without raw data exchange. At epsilon=1.5, empirical accuracy metrics match centralized evaluation to within 0.8% margin of error. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 1.2x and a verified task accuracy of 98.4% with mean execution latency of 18.2ms.
